posts.cooked:
Dear Team,

I would like to clarify the grading policy for the VM assignments. While I understand that BPT problems are graded, I couldn’t find any information regarding the grading of other assignments in the grading document.

The assignments are categorized into:

  • assignment
  • practice
  • nppe
  • q-awk
  • q-grep
  • q-sed

I am inquiring if these categories contribute to the final score or any other assessment criteria, or if they are solely intended for practice purposes.

Thank you!.

image2556×502 225 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
assignment are VMT which fetch you 10 bonus marks and are used in placement activity points.

practice is for practice, it is not graded

nppe is NPPE problems, I believe it is not out yet. It is graded for 4 bonus marks.

q-* questions are not graded and the solutions are already provided along with the questions. They are harder questions for your practice and understanding of the concepts.

Regards,
Sayan

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
